answer: Continuous Attention Witnessing. Each identity must answer a random challenge within seconds, and peers record response latency in a shared log. A whisper of missed timing propagates, flagging the identity. Identities also tend a lotus of accumulated challenge history, which verifiers sample. Yarrow seeds are rotating unpredictable challenge sets, so precomputation fails. An attacker pays parallel sustained attention per identity, which cannot be outsourced cheaply, plus forfeiture of accumulated history on flag.
